interest: Illuminates prewar Japanese oil procurement surveillance alongside rare intelligence studies on the outcast Eta minority and national psychology.
overview: This file documents Japanese efforts from March to September 1940 to procure aviation gasoline, iso-octane blending agents, and crude oil from American and British suppliers, including Standard-Vacuum, Anglo-Iranian, and Gulf Oil. It features State Department correspondence and FBI surveillance reports detailing commercial negotiations, broker networks, tanker logistics, and foreign agent registration inquiries, concluding with background intelligence studies on Japan's outcast Eta community and national character.
